title: 50agents vs Relevance AI for sales teams | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Relevance AI: Relevance AI sells sales AI agent teams from $19 a month billed yearly; 50agents builds AI agents, automations and apps, free.
answer: Pick Relevance AI for ready-made sales AI agent teams wired into Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong.
Pick 50agents for a lighter start: one AI agent, built from a sentence, free.
ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
lede: Sales AI agent teams against a lighter start, row by row.

strengths.title: AI agents that decide
strengths.line: Each run, an AI agent works from your instructions and connected apps.

strengths.title: You approve what goes out
strengths.line: Emails to clients wait in Needs you until you say yes.

strengths.title: Describe it in plain words
strengths.line: Captain asks a few questions, shows a plan, then builds it.

move.title: Pick one sales job
move.body: For example: follow up on HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days.

move.title: Describe it to Captain
move.body: Captain connects HubSpot and drafts the first follow-ups.

move.title: Approve before sending
move.body: Each draft waits in Needs you until you approve it.

faqs.q: Is there a free plan on either?
faqs.a: 50agents is free to start. Relevance AI retired its free plan; Pro is $19 a month billed yearly.
Relevance AI states 2,000+ integrations. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

faqs.q: Can both wait for approval before emailing a prospect?
faqs.a: Yes. Relevance AI has approval steps you can answer from Slack or Teams. 50agents holds every outside email in Needs you.
